budget_measurement_definition.statement: The registered ceiling is measured in actively used GPU-hours. VM wall-clock hours and allocated GPU-hours are reported separately and are not bound by that ceiling.

vm_wall_clock_hours.definition: elapsed hours during which each VM was in the running power state
vm_wall_clock_hours.note: accrues by operator decision; measured and reported, never used to argue for stopping anything

allocated_gpu_hours.definition: visible GPU count multiplied by the hours each GPU host was running

actively_used_gpu_hours.definition: GPU-seconds actually consumed by work this invocation performed, from the per-step gpu_seconds field of the journal, divided by 3600

r0_used_zero_accelerator_hours.why: R-0 is source reading, network acquisition and rule commitment; none of it touches a GPU

network_transfer.operator_constraint: all downloads are performed by the cloud VM, not by the operator's PC
network_transfer.endpoint_note: huggingface.co is unreachable from the GPU host and raw.githubusercontent.com times out; hf-mirror.com and api.github.com are used, and every file is verified against the digest the ORIGIN published at the pinned revision, so the transport cannot substitute bytes without detection

training_group_v100.note: authority section 3.6 requires these to remain running, remain idle and remain untouched; their correct role in this study is to stay unchanged

claim_ceiling: A resource record. It licenses no claim of any kind.
